facts.claim: Disney Treasure (Disney Cruise Line): Entered service 2024; 144,000 GT; 2500 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 348 m length; Wish class.
Disney Treasure is a cruise ship owned and operated by Disney Cruise Line, a subsidiary of the Walt Disney Company.
She is the sixth ship in the Disney Cruise Line fleet and the second vessel of the Wish class, following Disney Wish (2022).

catalogSpecs.description: Adventure-themed Wish-class sister to Disney Wish; entered service late 2024.
